 "description": "Offers students an opportunity, within a structured framework, to integrate academic learning with professional practice through a semester-long internship (16–20 hours per week) paired with a professional development course. Faculty mentorship and peer cohort discussions support reflection, professional skill development, adaptive problem solving, goal setting and monitoring, and communication skills. Students deliver tangible project outcomes to partner organizations and communicate their impact, learning, and professional growth through course deliverables, developing transferable skills and preparing for academic and career success.",
